latest_message:
Dear Pallavi,

You’re asking about the status of the AI interview you’ve already given.

Because I can’t see the specific interview record from this message, the fastest way is to check Flowmingo in your candidate dashboard (look for the section showing your interview results/insights). If you don’t see your results there, it usually means your interview recording wasn’t qualified for the AI-training dataset; you can still have other parts available depending on eligibility.

If you share the email you used for the interview, your device, and a screenshot of what you see in the dashboard, the team can confirm what’s currently available for you.

Let us know if you have any questions,

Best regards,

--
